overview_description.description:
NextPay has successfully enabled hundreds of e-commerce retailers offer convenient online payment options.

Over the years, they have helped hundreds of small and medium businesses provide secure and easy transaction options for purchasing online. 
Currently NextPay handles transactions for over 200 merchants, with a large part of the companies based in Latin America.

The business niches of their clients include apparel, electronics, hotels, education services, digital products, as well as many others.
